\section{Featured Projects}
    \resumeSubHeadingListStart
      \resumeProjectHeading
          {\textbf{1. Multichamber Muffler Design}}{2023}
          \resumeItemListStart
            \resumeItem{Designed a multichamber muffler system with internal components including chambers, baffles, perforates, and fiberglass absorbents.}
            \resumeItem{Simulated acoustic performance using industry-standard tools: ANSYS 2023 (Acoustics Module) and SIDLAB 5.1 (1D approximation).}
            \resumeItem{Modeled transmission and insertion loss across 0--1000 Hz using fluid approximations and validated against measured data.}
            \resumeItem{Created CAD-style schematics and published downloadable simulation files for reproducibility and benchmarking.}
          \resumeItemListEnd

      \resumeProjectHeading
          {\textbf{2. Viscoplastic Modeling}}{2023}
          \resumeItemListStart
            \resumeItem{Applied Anand's viscoplasticity model to simulate strain-rate and temperature-dependent behavior of solder alloys on microchip packages.}
            \resumeItem{Developed a Forward Euler integration scheme in Python to solve constitutive equations and model stress evolution to verify ANSYS nonlinear models.}
            \resumeItem{Performed material parameter fitting based on experimental data using Python NumPy.}
          \resumeItemListEnd

      \resumeProjectHeading
          {\textbf{3. Electromagnetics Simulation: Finite Difference Time Domain}}{2019}
          \resumeItemListStart
            \resumeItem{Calculated 3D space location of a particle in a magnetized fluid flow using the Yee Scheme.}
            \resumeItem{Implemented finite difference equations and staggered time-stepping for a Navier Stokes Simulation.}
          \resumeItemListEnd

      \resumeProjectHeading
          {\textbf{4. MSc Project -- POD Analysis of Turbulent Pipe Flow}}{2023}
          \resumeItemListStart
            \resumeItem{Developed a MATLAB-based framework to analyze turbulent rotating pipe flow using Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD).}
            \resumeItem{Compared Classic and Snapshot POD methods to extract dominant energetic structures and reconstruct flow fields from 5 Terabytes of data.}
            \resumeItem{Tools Used: MATLAB, Python, C++, fortran2020, linux.}
          \resumeItemListEnd
    \resumeSubHeadingListEnd
